SEARCH
Module jakarta.concurrency
Package jakarta.enterprise.concurrent

Annotation Interface Lock

@InterceptorBinding @Target({METHOD,TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Inherited public @interface Lock

A lock that governs concurrent access to a CDI managed bean.

When the Lock annotation is applied to a bean class or method, a single lock controls access to an instance of the bean. The lock is obtained, either in exclusive or shared mode, by invoking bean methods. If the bean implementation internally accesses one of its own methods or fields, that access is not subject to the lock.

A bean method that does not have a Lock annotation inherits the Lock annotation, if present, of the class that declares the method. A bean class that has a method annotated Lock, but does not have a Lock annotation of its own at the class level, operates according to the default values of the Lock annotation when bean methods that are not annotated Lock are invoked.

Since:

  • Element Details

    • type

      Lock.Type type

      Indicates whether to obtain the lock on the bean instance in exclusive or shared mode.

      Returns:
      The Lock.Type to use
      Default:
      WRITE

    • accessTimeout

      long accessTimeout

      The maximum amount of time to wait to obtain the lock. If the lock that allows running the method cannot be obtained within the specified amount of time, a CompletionException that chains a TimeoutException is thrown from the method invocation attempt.

      Use the IMMEDIATE constant to avoid waiting.

      Use the UNLIMITED constant to avoid timing out.

      The supplied timeout value must be positive or one of the constants described above.

      Returns:
      the time to wait to obtain a lock
      Default:
      60L

    • unit

      TimeUnit unit
      Returns:
      units used for the specified accessTimeout value.
      Default:
      SECONDS
